# Recovery check for a completed cohort whose final metadata write failed.
# It never launches a target, redraws a sample, or edits the executed script.
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess
root=Path('/home/akisarou/.cache/nts-scratch/760')
tree=Path('/home/akisarou/.cache/nts-pool/5')
expected='96efb519b77454da298716e54b0acb24d9094632'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','--no-optional-locks','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=tree,text=True).strip()==expected
manifest=json.loads((root/'real-cpu-v6/provenance.json').read_text())
assert manifest['source']==expected
assert manifest['binarySha256']==hashlib.sha256((tree/'target/release/nts').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert manifest['publication_recovery']['script_sha256']==hashlib.sha256((root/'real-cpu-v6.ts').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
rows=json.loads((root/'real-cpu-v6/rows.json').read_text())
assert len(rows)==24 and rows==manifest['rows']
for backend in ['c','llvm','jvm']:
    projections=[]
    for arm in 'abcdefgh':
        value=json.loads((root/'real-cpu-v6'/f'{backend}-{arm}-result.json').read_text())
        assert value['population']==500 and value['attempted']==500 and len(value['outcomes'])==500
        projections.append(json.dumps({key:value[key] for key in ['selected','population','attempted','tally','outcomes']},sort_keys=True))
    assert len(set(projections))==1
    assert manifest['product_projection_sha256'][backend]==hashlib.sha256(projections[0].encode()).hexdigest()
    off=[row for row in rows if row['name'].startswith(backend+'-') and not row['enabled']]
    on=[row for row in rows if row['name'].startswith(backend+'-') and row['enabled']]
    assert len(off)==len(on)==4
    print(backend, 'verified CPU ratio including collection',sum(row['cpu_s']+row['collection_cpu_s'] for row in on)/sum(row['cpu_s'] for row in off))
print('Completed cohort recovery verified without rerunning any target.')

provenance.status: stopped after the complete C cohort failed the CPU criterion

publication_recovery.reason: private measurement script omitted spawnSync import at final provenance write; all arms and product checks had completed
publication_recovery.method: saved rows and all eight per-backend outcome projections verified; tree remained frozen at the launch commit

source_commit_verification.method: read unchanged launch HEAD after all arms; executed script wrote its source description over the Git source field

production_configuration.step_wrapper: tooling/gate/run.mjs wraps with /usr/bin/time, never perf; the eight all.sh routes call the census directly
production_configuration.collection_cpu_measure: getrusage-self-v1, synchronous collector with no children
production_configuration.acceptance: ordinary step cgroup CPU plus separately charged ON collection CPU; counted instructions shown alongside, never mixed with ordinary CPU

canonical.wait_note: Ledger waits may overlap active work; not subtracted as an exclusive execution interval.

followup.change: one must_use diagnostic attribute on Session; generated locked dependency notices

measurement_notes: CPU ratios include separately observed collection CPU.
Perf inherited-event runs include fork/PMU observer cost and are separate from ordinary execution.
Earlier short/cohort, cold, stopped and unmeasured attempts remain under the protected scratch root; their status is recorded in the notebook.
